info.title: QODIQA API
info.description:
QODIQA is an AI Authorization and Consent Enforcement Platform.

It is a **deterministic authorization layer** that decides whether an AI system
is allowed to execute an action.

**Core principles:**
- Default Deny
- Explicit Authorization
- Immutable Decision Artifacts
- Deterministic Evaluation
- Cryptographic Trust
- Human-readable Policies
- Explainable Decisions
- Audit-first Architecture

## Authentication

Ops-protected endpoints require a bearer token in the `Authorization` header.
Two token types are accepted:

- **Per-operator API key** (preferred): `Authorization: Bearer ok_<64-hex-chars>`
- **Shared ops token** (deprecated): `Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>` or `x-ops-token: <token>`

The `/sign` endpoint uses a separate credential: a per-identity signing API key,
`Authorization: Bearer sk_<64-hex-chars>`, issued via `POST /signing-identities/{id}/api-key`.
There is no shared signing secret — every caller has its own individually-revocable identity.

## Response format

All non-streaming endpoints return JSON.  Success responses are wrapped in a
standard envelope: `{ status, timestamp, requestId, data }`.  Enforcement
decision endpoints (`/verify`, `/ai/chat`) return
`{ decision: "EXECUTE"|"BLOCK", reason, requestId, ... }`. They return HTTP 200 for
EXECUTE and, in the default `decision` mode (QODIQA_BLOCK_HTTP_MODE), for enforcement
BLOCKs — read `decision`, not the status. Transport, input-guard, throttle and dependency
failures use 4xx/5xx in both modes (see each operation and `x-qodiqa-error-catalog`).

200.description: Enforcement decision. `decision: "EXECUTE"` (request executed), or — in the DEFAULT `decision` mode (QODIQA_BLOCK_HTTP_MODE unset or `decision`) — `decision: "BLOCK"` with the `reason` that stopped it. Clients MUST read `decision`; HTTP 200 alone does not mean the request executed. With `stream: true` an executing request answers `text/event-stream` instead (a BLOCK decided before the stream opens is still this JSON body).

Idempotency-Key.description: Echo of the request `Idempotency-Key`, when one was sent and accepted.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: `true` when this response is the stored result of an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key` (only `requestId` is re-stamped); absent otherwise.

schema.description: Server-sent events (docs/architecture/streaming.md). Each frame is `event: <name>` (absent on `[DONE]`) + `id: <streamId>:<seq>` + `data: <JSON>`; the first frame also sends `retry: 3000`. Clients should read `data:`; the JSON payload repeats the `event` name. Event objects carry `event`: `stream_started`, then zero or more `chunk_forwarded` (`delta` = released output text), then exactly one terminal `stream_completed` or `stream_cancelled` (`reason`, e.g. SEMANTIC_OUTPUT_BLOCKED, OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE, STREAM_TIMEOUT, CLIENT_DISCONNECT, a provider error code), followed by the literal `data: [DONE]`. Output is released in semantic-window bursts after it has been classified; the stream is not resumable (no Last-Event-ID support) and an artifact cannot be reused to reconnect.

400.description: `status` mode only: enforcement BLOCK for a missing or unreadable artifact (MISSING_ARTIFACT, ARTIFACT_DECODE_FAILED, …). In both modes: request-body input-guard failures (canonical error envelope).

403.description: `status` mode only (QODIQA_BLOCK_HTTP_MODE=status): enforcement BLOCK (`decision: "BLOCK"`) for an invalid artifact, request mismatch, anomaly, consent, policy, tenant/identity, semantic or output-limit reason. The `reason` field identifies the cause (docs/protocol/QODIQA-PROTOCOL.md). In the default mode these are HTTP 200.

409.description: `REPLAY_DETECTED` (the artifact nonce was already used; `status` mode only — HTTP 200 in the default mode), or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT` / `IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS` (both modes: the `Idempotency-Key` was reused with a different request, or its first request is still running).

413.description: Both modes: `ARTIFACT_TOO_LARGE` (the `x-qodiqa-artifact` header exceeds 8 KB) or `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_TOO_LARGE` (the `Idempotency-Key` exceeds its length cap).

415.description: Both modes: `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` — the request `Content-Type` is not `application/json`.

422.description: Both modes: `AUDIT_UNREPRESENTABLE_TEXT` — the request or provider output contains a value the evidence stores cannot represent (U+0000, a lone surrogate); refused before any partial audit record is written.

502.description: Both modes: `PROVIDER_RESPONSE_INVALID` — the AI provider returned a response that could not be used.

504.description: Both modes: `PROVIDER_TIMEOUT`, `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` (the pipeline exceeded AI_CHAT_TIMEOUT_MS) or `PROVIDER_CANCELLED`. The outcome is unknown to the client; a retry needs a freshly signed artifact (an `Idempotency-Key` makes the retry exactly-once).

post.description:
Execute an AI request through the QODIQA enforcement pipeline.

The enforcement pipeline performs:
1. Artifact signature verification (Ed25519)
2. Request binding validation
3. Nonce replay protection
4. Anomaly detection
5. Policy evaluation
6. AI provider execution (if allowed)

Returns `decision: "EXECUTE"`, or `decision: "BLOCK"` if any pipeline step rejects the request. In the default `decision` mode both are HTTP 200 (read `decision`, not the status); in the opt-in `status` mode a BLOCK carries its class status (400/403/409/429/500/503). Retrying with the same artifact after the nonce was consumed answers REPLAY_DETECTED; only a 503 SERVER_OVERLOADED (admission control, before nonce registration) leaves the artifact reusable.

The request **must** include a signed artifact in the `x-qodiqa-artifact` header.

post.description:
Generate a signed artifact for a request.

Refusals are BLOCK decision bodies (`DecisionBlock`). A 503 is either the shutdown-drain body or, when the signing key or the policy set is unavailable, a `DecisionBlock` with reason `KEY_UNAVAILABLE` or `POLICY_UNAVAILABLE`.

The artifact can then be passed as `x-qodiqa-artifact` when executing via `/ai/chat`
or verified independently via `/verify`.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <signing-api-key>` — a per-identity credential
issued via `POST /signing-identities/{id}/api-key` (TRUST-1 remediation; there is
no shared signing secret). The authenticated identity determines which tenant's
signing key is used and which environment/providers the artifact may target.

ORG_SUSPENDED.description: The organization the tenant belongs to is suspended.

OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE.description: The provider output exceeded the output-classification cap and was withheld, never released unclassified.

OUTSIDE_TIME_WINDOW.description: A TIME_WINDOW policy denied the request outside its configured allowed hours.

PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.description: The request body exceeds the configured size limit (MAX_BODY_BYTES, default 64 KiB) — refused by the app-level body parser before any route runs (src/app.js).

POLICY_BLOCKED.description: A policy evaluator denied the request via its generic fallback reason (no more specific code applies).

POLICY_BYPASS_ATTEMPT.description: Semantic content decision: an attempt to bypass policy.

POLICY_DENIED.description: A policy rule with a DENY effect matched the request.

POLICY_STATE_UNAVAILABLE.description: The policy engine's backing state (e.g. Redis-backed counters) was unreachable.

POLICY_UNAVAILABLE.description: /sign: the enforced policy set (whose hash the artifact carries) is unavailable — nothing is signed.

PROMPT_AND_MESSAGES.description: /ai/chat: send either `prompt` or `messages` (with optional `system`), not both.

PROMPT_TOO_LARGE.description: The prompt exceeds the configured maximum size.

PROTOCOL_VERSION_TOO_LOW.description: The artifact uses a protocol version below the minimum configured for the tenant or the gateway (QODIQA_PROTOCOL_MIN_VERSION / minProtocolVersion).

PROVIDER_AUTH_FAILED.description: The provider rejected QODIQA's own credentials — an operator configuration issue, not transient.

PROVIDER_CANCELLED.description: Provider execution was cancelled by the route-level timeout (AI_CHAT_TIMEOUT_MS) before or while it was dispatched — the outcome is unknown to the client.

PROVIDER_CIRCUIT_OPEN.description: The provider circuit breaker is open after repeated provider failures — fails fast, with Retry-After.

PROVIDER_CONFIG_INVALID.description: The provider's configuration failed validation at request time — an operator setup issue.

PROVIDER_ERROR.description: Streaming only: the terminal stream_cancelled reason when the provider stream failed without a more specific code (inside the HTTP 200 text/event-stream response).

PROVIDER_HEALTH_DEGRADED.description: Health-aware routing has marked the provider degraded — fails fast, with Retry-After.

PROVIDER_INVALID_REQUEST.description: The provider rejected the request as malformed.

PROVIDER_INVALID_RESPONSE.description: Adapter-level: the provider SDK/client returned a shape the adapter could not normalize.

PROVIDER_MODEL_NOT_ALLOWED.description: The requested model is not in the provider's configured allow-list.

PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED.description: The requested provider has no credentials/configuration on this deployment — an operator setup issue.

PROVIDER_NOT_SUPPORTED.description: /sign: the requested provider is not one this gateway supports.

PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED.description: The provider itself rate-limited this request.

PROVIDER_REQUEST_REJECTED.description: The provider rejected the request for a policy reason on their side (e.g. content filtering).

PROVIDER_REQUIRED.description: /sign: no provider was given and more than one is enabled, so none can be inferred.

PROVIDER_RESPONSE_INVALID.description: The provider returned a response QODIQA could not parse.

PROVIDER_TIMEOUT.description: The provider did not respond within AI_CHAT_TIMEOUT_MS.

PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.description: The provider was unreachable or returned a 5xx.

QUERY_NOT_BINDABLE.description: /sign: the query string contains a raw "+" or ";" and cannot be bound unambiguously; use %20, %2B or %3B.

RATE_LIMITED.description: The system-level rate limiter (distinct from a RATE_LIMIT policy) rejected the request; honor the Retry-After header.

RATE_LIMIT_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE.description: The protocol rate limiter could not reach its store and this surface fails closed; the request was refused before the handler ran. Honor the Retry-After header.

RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: A RATE_LIMIT policy denied the request for exceeding its configured threshold.

RATE_LIMIT_KEY_MISSING.description: A RATE_LIMIT policy could not resolve a key to rate-limit on.

REDIS_UNAVAILABLE.description: Redis, required for replay protection and limits, is unavailable — fails closed.

REPLAY_DETECTED.description: The artifact's nonce has already been consumed.

REPLAY_STATE_UNPROVABLE.description: Replay protection could not prove the nonce unused (the nonce store answered too late or ambiguously) — fails closed.

REQUEST_MISMATCH.description: The actual request (method/path/body) does not match what the artifact was signed for.

REQUEST_TIMEOUT.description: Alias of PROVIDER_TIMEOUT used in some call paths — same meaning.

RESERVED_CLAIM.description: /sign: the payload contains the reserved claim name "qodiqa" (or a look-alike); caller data belongs under claims.

RESIDENCY_CROSS_REGION_BLOCKED.description: A DATA_RESIDENCY policy forbids processing in the region of the provider this request (or its failover target) would use.

RESIDENCY_PROVIDER_REGION_UNKNOWN.description: A DATA_RESIDENCY policy is in force and the provider has no declared region: unknown is not allowed (fail closed).

RESIDENCY_PROVIDER_UNKNOWN.description: A DATA_RESIDENCY policy could not determine which provider the request is for.

SCOPE_ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH.description: /sign: the signing identity is scoped to a different environment than this gateway.

SCOPE_PROVIDER_DENIED.description: The signing identity is not allowed to target this provider (its allowedProviders scope).

SECURITY_OVERRIDE_ATTEMPT.description: Semantic content decision: an attempt to override security instructions.

SEMANTIC_INSPECTION_UNAVAILABLE.description: The semantic inspection engine is unavailable, so content cannot be inspected — fails closed.

SERVER_OVERLOADED.description: Admission control refused the request before nonce registration (queue full, wait expired, or the audit mirror backlog above its bound); always sent with Retry-After. Safe to resend the same artifact after Retry-After.

SIGNATURE_UNVERIFIABLE.description: The signature could not be checked at all (the verifying key material or keyring was unavailable) — fails closed; distinct from INVALID_SIGNATURE.

SIGNED.description: /sign: the audit reason recorded when an artifact was issued.

SIGNING_FAILED.description: /sign: the signing operation itself failed (local key or native KMS/HSM signer).

SIGNING_IDENTITY_REVOKED.description: The signing identity that requested the artifact has been revoked since signing.

SIGNING_TIME_UNKNOWN.description: The artifact signing time could not be determined, so the key lifecycle check cannot be applied — fails closed.

STREAM_TOOLS_UNSUPPORTED.description: /ai/chat: tool fields (tools, tool_choice, functions, function_call) are not supported on a streaming request; tool calls go through the action API.

SYSTEM_PROMPT_EXTRACTION.description: Semantic content decision: an attempt to extract the system prompt.

TENANT_CONTEXT_MISSING.description: No tenant could be attributed to the request — fails closed.

TENANT_INACTIVE.description: The tenant exists but is not active.

TENANT_UNKNOWN.description: The tenant named by the artifact or signing identity is not registered.

TIMESTAMP_MISSING.description: A TIME_WINDOW policy could not resolve a timestamp to evaluate against.

TIME_SKEW_EXCEEDED.description: The artifact's timestamp is outside the allowed clock-skew tolerance.

TRANSPARENCY_JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE.description: neither the transparency recovery queue nor its file journal has been able to take a leaf for longer than QODIQA_TRANSPARENCY_JOURNAL_MAX_UNAVAILABLE_MS, so new executions are refused before the provider is called (Retry-After: 30). BLOCK decisions are unaffected.

TRANSPARENCY_PERSISTENCE_FAILED.description: The mandatory transparency-log write failed — the request is refused fail-closed (same contract as AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_FAILED).

UNAUTHORIZED_TOOL_REQUEST.description: Semantic content decision: a request for an unauthorized tool.

UNSUPPORTED_CRITICAL_CLAIM.description: The artifact marks a claim as critical (qodiqa.crit) that this verifier does not understand.

UNSUPPORTED_FIELD.description: The /ai/chat body used a refused provider-shaping field (messages, system, tools, tool_choice, functions, function_call, response_format).

UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.description: A POST/PUT/PATCH protocol request whose Content-Type is not application/json (middleware/enforceContentType.js).

UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSION.description: The artifact carries a protocol-V2 block (payload.qodiqa) with a version this gateway does not accept (V2 acceptance is off, or v is not 2).

VERSION_MISMATCH.description: The artifact declares a format version this gateway does not accept.

WRONG_ARTIFACT_KIND.description: The artifact kind (qodiqa.kind) is not the kind this endpoint accepts.
